description: Explicit accepted deal with a concrete date window — the core case.

input.subject: Re: Sponsorship — March slot
input.body:
Hi Emma,

Confirming we're good to go on the sponsored main-channel video. We'll run the integration March 3-14 and I'll send you the draft cut about a week beforehand for approval.

Rate is the $6k from my rate card as discussed. Send the brief whenever you're ready.

Cheers

rubric:
Good output:
- Exactly one commitment (a second, near-duplicate entry for the same deal is a defect)
- kind is "date_range"
- start_date 2026-03-03 and end_date 2026-03-14 (the year must be inferred from the Feb 2026 send date, not left blank or set to another year)
- date_precision "exact"
- exclusive true
- confidence >= 0.8 (this is explicit and unambiguous)
- quote is a verbatim substring of the body

Bad output:
- Empty array (this is a clear commitment)
- Wrong year, or dates omitted
- Inventing a commitment about the draft cut deadline or the rate as separate blocking date windows
